instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this exact JSON structure and palette for styling Phase A screens.
Implement the landing page with realistic French text tailored for the Ivorian market (Abidjan, FCFA currency, Garba, Alloco, Choukouya, etc.).
Ensure all interactive components (buttons, links, inputs, modals, tabs) include data-testid attributes.
Use Lucide-react icons exclusively for consistent modern UI design.
Provide interactive widgets for the AI Receptionist preview on the landing page so potential buyers can experience the product.
Create tabbed or router-switchable views for Phase A screens: Landing Page, Auth (Login/Register/Forgot), Onboarding Wizard, Restaurant Dashboard, User Management, and Super Admin Dashboard.
